name: klytos/vendor-ai-manifest
description: Reconstructed manifest for the vendored AI-chat dependency tree in installer/vendor-ai/. NOT a runtime dependency manifest: Klytos ships vendor-ai/ pre-installed and never runs Composer on an installed site. This file exists so the vendored tree can be audited (composer audit) and reproduced byte-for-byte. Every package is pinned to the exact version currently vendored, transitive ones included, so the resolved set can never drift away from what actually ships. See docs/decisions.md D-028.
